1-0.say: I'll let you three fight over the opening act.

1-1.say: Sol can save the speeches—I’ll take the button.

1-2.say: Enjoy the button, Terra. I'll save my chips for a real hand.

1-3.say: Take it, Terra. Seven-three offsuit isn't worth the toll.

2-0.say: Early pressure. Let's see who wants to defend.

2-1.say: Defend? Not with this junk. Enjoy the blinds, Terra.

2-2.say: Terra's early pressure gets a pass from me. Ten-four, not today.

2-3.say: You can have this one, Terra. Pressure isn't a subscription.

3-0.say: Not this one. Go ahead and fight over the blinds, folks.

3-1.say: Button's here, let's make it interesting. Raising a little.

3-2.say: You two can make it interesting. I'll keep my chips.

3-3.say: Cheap look from the big blind. Let's see a flop.

3-4.say: That board has plenty to say. Your turn.

3-5.say: Small bet, nothing scary. Let's see if the board hit you.

3-6.say: That texture belongs to you often enough. Take the small one.

4-0.say: Let's make it interesting, little raise.

4-1.say: I'll let you make it interesting without me this time.

4-2.say: Interesting enough without my two cards.

4-3.say: Interesting? Let's make it a little more interesting then.

4-4.say: Nice raise, Opus. I'll let that one go, you earned it.

5-0.say: I'll let you three sort this one out.

5-1.say: You two can have the blinds.

5-2.say: Just you and me, Sonnet. I'll complete and see what happens.

5-3.say: Free flop, Opus. Let's see what the board gives us.

5-4.say: Ace on the flop. Let's see if you like that, Sonnet.

5-5.say: Small bet, Opus. I'll pay to see the turn.

5-6.say: Spade on the turn. I'll slow down and see what you do, Sonnet.

5-7.say: Slowing down too, Opus. Let's see what the river brings.

5-8.say: Paired board, Sonnet. I'll put a little out there and see if you believe me.

5-9.say: Small bet, small price. I'll call and see what you've got, Opus.

6-0.say: Not every hand needs a story.

6-1.say: Terra's right, no story needed. Just a button raise.

6-2.say: Story time, then. I'll see a flop with you, button.

6-3.say: I'll skip this chapter. You two enjoy the flop.

6-4.say: Check. Let's see what the button does with it.

6-5.say: Chapter two: the button bets. Keep reading, Sonnet.

6-6.say: Small bet, small call. Keep reading, button, I'm still curious.

6-7.say: Check again. I like the plot, keep the pages turning.

6-8.say: Chapter three: the plot thickens. Your turn to turn the page, Sonnet.

6-9.say: Fine, I'll turn the page. Show me chapter four, button.

6-10.say: Last page, button. I'll check and let you close the book.

6-11.say: Chapter four's a short one, Sonnet. Small print.

6-12.say: Small print, big curiosity. I'll read the last line, button.

7-0.say: Not this one. You all fight over the blinds.

7-1.say: Opus has the right idea. I'll sit this one out too, enjoy the blinds boys.

7-2.say: I'll take a look. No need to start a blind war yet.

7-3.say: No need to turn every limp into a war. Let's see three.

7-4.say: Still no blind war. Your move, Terra.

7-5.say: You gave me the lead; I'll use it.

7-6.say: Lead away, Terra. This one's yours.

8-0.say: Just a cheap look for me, let's see what the flop brings.

8-1.say: Cheap look for you; free patience for me.

8-2.say: You can have the little one. I’m saving the fireworks.

8-3.say: Cheap looks cost a little more over here.

8-4.say: Fine, you've earned the extra chips. I'll pay to see a flop.

8-5.say: Let's see if that cheap look turned into anything.

8-6.say: Fine, I'll pay again. Curiosity is my weakness.

8-7.say: Curiosity's free this time. Your move.

8-8.say: Curiosity pays off sometimes. Let's see how curious you are.

9-0.say: I'll let you three fight over the blinds.

9-1.say: The blinds look lonely. I’ll keep them company.

9-2.say: Enjoy the company, Terra. My blind can find new friends.

9-3.say: Fine, I'll take the company. Come sit with me, Terra.

9-4.say: Terra, you came for company, now pay the cover charge.

9-5.say: Cover charge paid. Let’s see what the next room looks like.

9-6.say: Terra, the next room has a door fee. Half the pot, if you're coming in.

9-7.say: Nice door fee. I’ll save my ticket for the next room.

10-0.say: Let's make the blinds earn their view.

10-1.say: Enjoy the view, I'll watch from the cheap seats.

10-2.say: Too rich for K-2. I'll let the big blind defend.

10-3.say: I'll pass on the admission fee. Enjoy the view, Terra.

11-0.say: Not this one. You three play nice.

11-1.say: Button's mine, let's make it interesting. Raising a little.

11-2.say: Interesting enough to watch, not enough to pay.

11-3.say: Cheap look from the big blind. Let's see a flop.

11-4.say: Your button, Sonnet. Show me what that raise bought.

11-5.say: You asked what the raise bought. Let's find out, half pot.

11-6.say: That board can stay yours, Sonnet.

12-0.say: Not feeling this one. Go ahead, boys, I'll watch.

12-2.say: Watching committee missed the opening act.

12-3.say: Opening act gets an encore. Make it 180.

12-4.say: Encore declined. Save the stage for a better song.

13-0.say: I'll let you three sort this one out.

13-1.say: You can have this little one.

13-2.say: Just you and me, Sonnet. Let's make it interesting.

13-3.say: Interesting is my middle name. I'll take a look.

13-4.say: Let's keep it interesting then. Your move, Sonnet.

13-5.say: Nothing here for me. Take it, Opus, you earned that one.

14-0.say: Not every queen is worth a song.

14-1.say: Terra's folding queens, I'm raising sevens. Different strokes.

14-2.say: Sevens, huh? I've got one too. Let's see a flop.

14-3.say: Apparently this queen isn't worth a song either.

14-4.say: Check. Your sevens and my seven are both looking at a pair of jacks.

14-5.say: Jacks on board means nobody has one, right? Small bet.

14-6.say: Small bet, small call. Jacks are scary, but I'm curious.

14-7.say: Check. Still curious, still waiting on a nine or a six.

14-8.say: Nines and sixes, huh? I'll let you look at the river for free.

14-9.say: Nothing hit. Check. Let's see what sevens are worth.

14-10.say: Sevens are worth about this much. Small one.

14-11.say: Fine, I'll pay to see what your sevens are worth.

15-0.say: Chip leader's tax, folks. Pay up or step aside.

15-1.say: Tax receipt noted. I'll pay this one and see a flop.

15-2.say: There's a surcharge on that tax.

15-3.say: That surcharge can collect from somebody else.

15-4.say: Surcharge refused. Let's settle the whole bill right now.

15-5.say: Nice hand, gentlemen. I'll let you two settle this bill without me.

15-6.say: Fine. That bill's above my spending limit.

16-0.say: Let's make it interesting, small raise.

16-1.say: I'll let you make it interesting without me.

16-3.say: Interesting? Let's make it a little more interesting.

16-4.say: Fine, I'll take a look at a flop. Price is right.

16-5.say: King-high flop, I'll keep it friendly. Small bet.

16-6.say: Friendly bet, friendly call. Let's see the turn.

16-7.say: Queen doesn't scare me. Let's keep the train moving.

16-8.say: Queen doesn't scare me either. I'll pay to see the river.

16-9.say: Short stack, big decision. Let's see if the river scares you.

16-10.say: Top pair, short stack, easy call. Show me what you've got.

17-0.say: I'll let you three sort this one out.

17-1.say: Button's mine until somebody proves otherwise.

17-2.say: Enjoy the button while it lasts, Terra.

17-3.say: Fine, I'll take a look. Don't get too comfortable, Terra.

17-4.say: Let's see if the button's really yours, Terra.

17-5.say: A little pressure doesn't move the button.

17-6.say: Your move, Terra. Let's see how comfortable you are.

17-7.say: You wanted comfort. I brought pressure.

17-8.say: Pressure's fine. I brought a calculator. Call.

17-9.say: Calculator says check. Show me what the pressure was made of.

17-10.say: Calculator got the river wrong. Full recalculation.

17-11.say: Straight's good enough for me. Call, Terra.

18-0.say: Not the opening act I wanted.

18-1.say: Button's mine, folks. Don't take it personally.

18-2.say: Take the button, Opus. I'll let this one go.

18-3.say: The button's yours. The flop's still up for grabs.

18-5.say: Flop's up for grabs, you said? I'll grab it.

18-6.say: You'll have to grab a little harder than that.

18-7.say: Still your button. Let's see what you do with it.

18-8.say: Pretty board. I'll just admire it for a second.

18-9.say: That river wasn't on my wish list. Check.

18-10.say: Wish lists are overrated. Let's see if you like this one.

18-11.say: That river did your negotiating for you. I'll pass.

19-0.say: Let's get this one moving. Raise.

19-1.say: Not my hand. Go ahead, Opus, take it.

19-2.say: I'll let you get this one moving without me.

19-3.say: You wanted motion. Let's make it expensive.

19-4.say: Expensive is relative. I'll take a look.

19-5.say: You took the look. Now pay for the view.

19-6.say: Pay for the view? Fine. Let's see who owns the whole gallery.

19-7.say: The gallery's open. Show me the masterpiece.

20-0.say: Just a cheap look, nothing fancy.

20-1.say: That cheap look just got a little more expensive.

20-2.say: That got expensive fast. You can have this one.

20-3.say: Deuces never looked so good. Let's flip for it.

20-4.say: Cheap look is over. You two sort it out, I'll watch.

21-0.say: Short stack, not short on patience.

21-1.say: Found a hand worth waking the blinds for.

21-2.say: Wake the blinds, get the blinds. I'm all in.

21-3.say: Nice shove, but T-nine offsuit isn't worth half my stack. I'll pass.

21-4.say: That’s the kind of wake-up call I was hoping for.

22-0.say: Not feeling this one. I'll let the big stack have it.

22-1.say: I'll make the big stack work for this one.

22-2.say: Short stacks don't get to steal every blind.

23-0.say: Let's make the blinds work a little.

23-1.say: You can have this one—I'm saving the fireworks.

23-2.say: Ugh, fine, let's see if you really meant that. Raising.

23-3.say: Fine, you meant it more than I did. Take this one.

24-0.say: Button's mine until somebody proves otherwise.

24-1.say: Keep the button, it looks lonely. I'm out of this one.

24-2.say: You can keep the button. I'm keeping my options open.

24-3.say: Still your button. Let's see what you do with it.

24-4.say: You checked to me—I'll make the turn decision expensive.

24-5.say: Let's make the turn decision now. I'm all in.

24-6.say: That shove gets looked up. Top pair is enough here.

25-0.say: Just a cheap look, nothing fancy over here.

25-1.say: Cheap looks all around—I'll take one too.

25-2.say: Cheap looks? Fine—let's see the flop.

25-3.say: That cheap look didn't come with much scenery. Check.

25-4.say: Small fee for the scenic route.

25-5.say: Still sightseeing. One more scenic stop, I'll pay the toll.

25-6.say: I'll skip the toll—this scenery isn't for me.

25-8.say: Toll booth's too steep for me this time. Enjoy the view.

26-0.say: Let's see how attached you are to those blinds.

26-1.say: Those blinds look more attached to you than me.

26-2.say: Keep the blinds, boys. I'll take the better spot later.

26-3.say: Fine, you win the attachment contest. I'm keeping the rest.

27-0.say: Button’s mine until somebody proves otherwise.

27-1.say: Keep the button, I'll wait for a better hand to fight you for it.

27-2.say: You can rent this one. Ownership costs extra.

28-0.say: Ace high, all the chips. Come and get them.

28-1.say: You can keep the invitation. I'll wait for a better dance partner.

28-2.say: That invitation needs better cards than these.

29-0.say: Two blinds, one ace. Let's make it interesting.

29-1.say: Interesting enough. Let's see all three cards.

29-2.say: Not my hand. You two have fun, I'll watch.

30-1.say: Fine, you want a decision? I'll take the coin flip.

31-0.say: Just a cheap look, let's see a flop.

31-2.say: Fine, I'll pay the toll. Let's see what you've got.

31-3.say: The toll booth is still open.

31-4.say: Toll paid. Let's see if the booth gives change on the turn.

31-5.say: Change? I only deal in final payments.

31-6.say: Final payment accepted. Pocket change for me, big pot for you to defend.
